name: tool-inspector-workspace
description: Workspace for Tool Inspector's core, OpenCode and Kilo packages

scripts.format: prettier --write packages/*/src packages/*/tests packages/*/package.json packages/*/tsconfig*.json tests scripts package.json tsconfig.json *.config.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check packages/*/src packages/*/tests packages/*/package.json packages/*/tsconfig*.json tests scripts package.json tsconfig.json *.config.mjs
scripts.test:package: npm run build && npm run test:package --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check:static: concurrently --names typecheck,lint,format --kill-others-on-fail "npm run typecheck" "npm run lint" "npm run format:check"
